run_save_sharded_state: run save_sharded_state.py to save a tensor-parallel model's sharded checkpoint to an output directory
run_save_sharded_state_with_quantization: run save_sharded_state.py with quantization and tensor-parallel-size to shard a deepspeedfp model checkpoint
run_save_sharded_state_custom_pattern: run save_sharded_state.py with a custom file-pattern and max-file-size for sharded safetensors output
run_save_sharded_state_copy_metadata: run save_sharded_state.py to save sharded weights and copy metadata files to the output directory
run_save_sharded_state_load_format: run save_sharded_state.py then load the checkpoint with Engine using load_format sharded_state
